note.text: Pointer only: this resource holds metadata, not pixels. The image is an entry in the ARex manifest arex-manifest-radiographs. By the project's convention (decision F25) the second identifier above repeats the manifest's transaction-context business identifier (urn:ohia:referral-id|REF-2026-UC07-001), so a consumer finds the manifest with the ARex search parameter transaction-identifier. DICOM UIDs are synthetic (2.25.*) and no DICOM object exists behind them.
